seoTitle: Bangladesh Electronic Music Scene: The Electric Rise
metaDescription: Witness the electric rise of the Bangladesh electronic music scene: an early B-POP Tags post on the lights, crowds and energy behind the new sound.
summaryBn: ‘উইটনেস দ্য ইলেকট্রিক রাইজ অফ বাংলাদেশ’ — এই এক লাইনে বি-পপ ট্যাগস জানিয়ে দেয় দেশের নতুন সাউন্ডের কথা। ডিস্কো বল, আলোর ঝলক আর ভিড়ে ভরা ছবিটি সেই শক্তিরই প্রতিচ্ছবি।
lede: One line, one image: B-POP Tags invites you to witness the electric rise of Bangladesh's sound.
body:
"Witness the ELECTRIC rise of Bangladesh." Posted on the same day as our very first post, this one-liner and a pair of headphones set out what B-POP Tags would spend its time on: the Bangladesh electronic music scene and the people pushing it forward.

## A snapshot of the Bangladesh electronic music scene

The cover does the talking. Beneath the pink B-POP Tags logo is a photo washed in violet and molten orange: a mirror ball hanging from the ceiling, stage lights blazing, beams of light cutting across the floor, and a few figures in the haze. It's the kind of room many people in Dhaka's independent music scene will recognise, the small, self-organised spaces where much of the new sound has grown.

## Follow the current

Our [Music & Rave](topic:music) section tracks that rise in detail. Start with [OMDG and the genesis of Bangladesh's rave revolution](post:omdg-dhaka-rave-revolution), relive [DJ Amit Kirti's set inside the Metro Rail](post:dj-amit-kirti-metro-rail-dj-set), and read how [DJ Shimmerie keeps Dhaka's underground parties going](post:dj-shimmerie-dhaka-underground-parties). For where it all started, see [The Beginning](post:the-beginning-bpop-tags), or explore everything from the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcUdxfMkuhA/)
